changelog: Module 4: explicit from-policy (ARROBO_CO_MAIL_FROM_POLICY = strict|woo, default strict, priority 9999). Optional Reply-To via ARROBO_CO_MAIL_REPLY_TO. Module 12 (NEW): own mail log — rolling 100-entry buffer of every wp_mail attempt, metadata only, viewable at Tools → Arrobo Mail Log. Independent of host log retention.
